ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #9
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Waste food daily
   B. Destroy trees without planting
   C. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   D. Pollute rivers deliberately

2. Which response best shows understanding of Dimensions of Morality in Islam 04 5.2 Virtues in Islam 05 5.3 Prohibitions in I? (1 mark)
   A. Say Dimensions of Morality in Islam 04 5.2 Virtues in Islam 05 5.3 Prohibitions in I has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Dimensions of Morality in Islam 04 5.2 Virtues in Islam 05 5.3 Prohibitions in I to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Dimensions of Morality in Islam 04 5.2 Virtues in Islam 05 5.3 Prohibitions in I with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Dimensions of Morality in Islam 04 5.2 Virtues in Islam 05 5.3 Prohibitions in I.

3. Which response best shows understanding of Significance of Tawhid? (1 mark)
   A. Say Significance of Tawhid has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Significance of Tawhid with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Significance of Tawhid to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Significance of Tawhid.

4. Which response best shows understanding of Selected Chapters 90:1? (1 mark)
   A. Use Selected Chapters 90:1 to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Selected Chapters 90:1 has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected Chapters 90:1.
   D. Apply the teaching of Selected Chapters 90:1 with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Saum ,? (1 mark)
   A. Use Saum , to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Saum ,.
   C. Apply the teaching of Saum , with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Saum , has no place in daily life.

6. Which response best shows understanding of Zakat and Zakatul Fitr? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Zakat and Zakatul Fitr.
   B. Apply the teaching of Zakat and Zakatul Fitr with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Zakat and Zakatul Fitr to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Zakat and Zakatul Fitr has no place in daily life.

7. Which response best shows understanding of Ulumul Qur’an? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Ulumul Qur’an with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Ulumul Qur’an has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Ulumul Qur’an.
   D. Use Ulumul Qur’an to insult classmates of other faiths.

8. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Refusing to help a neighbour
   B. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   C. Skipping all moral lessons
   D. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

9. Which response best shows understanding of Swalah prayers occasions (Swalatul, Janaza, Musafir, Kusuf, and Khusuf),? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Swalah prayers occasions (Swalatul, Janaza, Musafir, Kusuf, and Khusuf), with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Swalah prayers occasions (Swalatul, Janaza, Musafir, Kusuf, and Khusuf), to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Swalah prayers occasions (Swalatul, Janaza, Musafir, Kusuf, and Khusuf), has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Swalah prayers occasions (Swalatul, Janaza, Musafir, Kusuf, and Khusuf),.

10. Which response best shows understanding of Shirk of Shirk Shirk? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Shirk of Shirk Shirk with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Shirk of Shirk Shirk has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Shirk of Shirk Shirk.
   D. Use Shirk of Shirk Shirk to insult classmates of other faiths.

11. Which response best shows understanding of Selected Hadith intention the choice of friends? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Selected Hadith intention the choice of friends with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected Hadith intention the choice of friends.
   C. Use Selected Hadith intention the choice of friends to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Selected Hadith intention the choice of friends has no place in daily life.

12. Which response best shows understanding of Dimensions of Morality in Islam? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Dimensions of Morality in Islam.
   B. Apply the teaching of Dimensions of Morality in Islam with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say Dimensions of Morality in Islam has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Dimensions of Morality in Islam to insult classmates of other faiths.

13. Which response best shows understanding of Swalah 10 4.2 Zakat 05 4.3 Saum 05 5 Akhlaq 5.1 Dimensions of Morality in Islam ? (1 mark)
   A. Use Swalah 10 4.2 Zakat 05 4.3 Saum 05 5 Akhlaq 5.1 Dimensions of Morality in Islam  to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Swalah 10 4.2 Zakat 05 4.3 Saum 05 5 Akhlaq 5.1 Dimensions of Morality in Islam  has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Swalah 10 4.2 Zakat 05 4.3 Saum 05 5 Akhlaq 5.1 Dimensions of Morality in Islam .
   D. Apply the teaching of Swalah 10 4.2 Zakat 05 4.3 Saum 05 5 Akhlaq 5.1 Dimensions of Morality in Islam  with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

14. Which response best shows understanding of Ulumul Hadith Hadith of Hadith Hadith Hadith? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Ulumul Hadith Hadith of Hadith Hadith Hadith with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Ulumul Hadith Hadith of Hadith Hadith Hadith has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Ulumul Hadith Hadith of Hadith Hadith Hadith.
   D. Use Ulumul Hadith Hadith of Hadith Hadith Hadith to insult classmates of other faiths.

15. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Spreading rumours
   B. Cheating in exams
   C. Hiding stolen items
   D. Telling the truth and keeping trust

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. In three clear sentences, explain Saum , and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Dimensions of Morality in Islam 04 5.2 Virtues in Islam 05 5.3 Prohibitions in I and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Dimensions of Morality in Islam and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Virtues in Islam 05 5.3 Prohibitions in Islam 08 6 Muamalat 6.1 Marriage 06 6.2  and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Virtues in Islam and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Prohibitions in Islam and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
